text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- President Ben Ali congratulates the Tunisian trade unions organisation at the occasion of the celebration of its 51rst anniversary. Says he was confident of the "constructive role" trade unions will continue to play in the country.
- Privatisation of municipality services in some areas of the city of Sousse.
- Tunisia's oil production decreases by an average five percent per year.
- Tunisia last week exported about 20 tonnes tomatoes to France and 12 tonnes to Canada.
